content:
KAMRUI is offering up to a 35% discount on three of its AMD Ryzen 5/7 and Intel Core mini PCs. Let’s check all three. KAMRUI E3B mini PC –  AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 7640HS, 24GB LPDDR5, 512 GB SSD This model features a 6-core/12-thread AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 7640HS Zen 4 processor clocked up to 5.0 GHz, paired with 24GB of soldered-on LPDDR5 memory, and a 512GB NVMe SSD installed in one of the two M.2 2280 SSD slots. Other interfaces include a full-function USB 3.2 Gen Type-C port that supports charging, data transfer (10Gbps), and 4K/60Hz display output, DisplayPort 1.4b and HDMI 2.0 video output for up to three independent displays,  Gigabit Ethernet, two USB3.2 Gen2 (10Gbps) ports, four USB3.2 Gen1 Type-A (5Gbps) ports, and a 3.5mm audio jack.
